messages:
Priya: quick sync — starting a small sprint-zero for the evals/tooling work. need to lock launch guardrails + list of customer-driven constraints. who can join an 11am sync?
Ethan: i can. heads-up: main asks are intelligent batching defaults + per-customer cache invalidation controls. also want perf targets to be explicit.
Maya: can do. we saw caching improves throughput but sometimes hurts quality on narrow prompt sets. we should define regression gates.
Rob: customer asks we've heard: per-route TTL, 'pin' to avoid serving stale cached completions, and safe rollback to cold path. also two customers want opt-in beta.
Lina: from eval side — there are 3 promptsets that show token-level drift after quantization. we need automated checks that run against deployed configs.
Ashley: UX ask: surface tradeoffs in console (expected cost reduction, latency change, quality risk) and a simple toggle for beta customers. keep it minimal.
Priya: proposed minimum launch criteria: 1) >=20% median cost/token improvement on chat benchmark OR equivalent throughput gain; 2) regression rate <1% on critical promptset suite; 3) admin controls: TTL, pin, canary rollout + rollback. feedback?
Ethan: 20% is ambitious but possible if we combine KV prefix caching + adaptive batching. need a perf prototype to validate numbers.
Maya: agree on prototype. we also need an "eval-runner" that does end-to-end scoring against live configs (not just offline). will write a recipe.
Lina: propose regression metric: % of prompts where top-1 token prob drops by >0.05 relative to baseline. we can also track semantic similarity fallback.
Rob: timeline note — two HS customers want HIPAA-compatible private beta. that means security gating and a separate rollout plan; could push GA.
Priya: ok action items (owners): Ethan -> perf prototype by next Tue; Maya -> eval-runner recipe + run against 3 promptsets; Lina -> final regression thresholds and alert rules; Rob -> confirm 2 beta customers and HIPAA checklist; Ashley -> mock admin toggles for console.
Ethan: will try to land a small perf branch and attach benchmarks. expect noisy numbers but useful.
Maya: adding to PR description a sample command for eval-runner:
```
./eval-runner --config configs/chat-caching.yaml --promptset critical-v1 --report s3://redwood-evals/reports
```
Lina: will produce a tiny rubric for severity (minor/major/blocker) tied to percent drift.
Sam: deploy-bot: perf-proto branch CI passed, canary artifact uploaded.
Priya: perfect. please post any cross-team blockers here. syncing tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup: 
Ethan: noted — i'll post preliminary numbers once CI artifacts finish.
Rob: i'll DM legal + security about HIPAA checklist and post back.
Ashley: will share 2 quick mockups before EOD.
Maya: starting eval-runner infra ticket now.
Priya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for async updates.
